stem: Which sentences from the selection “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening” best express a SIMILAR feeling?
instruction:
Use “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening” and “Assembly” to answer the following question.

Read lines 16–19 from the poem “Assembly.”

Manny nudges me
when it’s time for my solo.
Legs like spaghetti,
I worry that I might faint.

options.label: F
options.text: He was nervous to speak in front of a large group of people. He needed help. (paragraph 2)

options.label: G
options.text: Dexter seems to like his volunteer job. His excitement might have something to do with the bag of treats. (paragraph 6)

options.label: H
options.text: It doesn’t matter if students mess up. The dogs won’t know if they do. (paragraph 8)

options.label: J
options.text: She will be speaking in front of about 4,000 people on graduation day. But, today she is only giving a speech to one audience member, and it is a dog named Noche. (paragraph 14)
